tone: PLAN §8.8: warm, brief, plain, never judgemental, at most 3 sentences. No food or day is good or bad. No deadlines, no fasting plans, no intake below the floor. Under-18 and habits-only users never see calorie numbers or deficit language.

placeholders.name: q05 preferred_name. Every line using {name} has a NoName twin or is safe to drop the name from.
placeholders.kcal: Formatted integer with thousands separator, e.g. 2,100
placeholders.remainingKcal: Daily target minus eaten, never negative
placeholders.category: breakfast | lunch | dinner | snack (lower case in sentences)
placeholders.d: Integer count of days in the period
placeholders.price: Store price string from RevenueCat in the user's currency (never hard-coded)
placeholders.savingPct: Rounded saving of yearly versus twelve monthly payments
placeholders.topic: Short topic named by the safety rules, e.g. diabetes
placeholders.retryAfterMin: Minutes from AI_UNAVAILABLE retryAfterSec, rounded up

prerender: Lines without {placeholders} are canonical and pre-rendered to tts/{version}/{lineId}.mp3 (PLAN §8.7). Lines with placeholders are spoken with on-device synthesis.

welcome.title.text: A healthier routine starts with a conversation.

welcome.sub.text: Meet Milo, your nutrition companion. Set your goal, understand your meals, and follow your daily progress.

welcome.cta.resume.text: Pick up where I left off

setup.intro.title.text: Let's set this up together, at your pace.

setup.intro.sub.text: Tap through a few questions. Everything after the first one can be skipped and changed later.

setup.hello.text: Hi, I am Milo. I will ask a few easy questions.

setup.maxReached.text: Up to {n} for now. Tap one to swap it.

setup.dobFuture.text: That date is in the future. Try again.

setup.under18.text: Thanks. I will keep things to habit tracking for now.

setup.unusualValue.text: That's outside the usual range. Is {value} right?

setup.finishLater.text: No rush. Your answers are saved.

setup.allDone.text: All done. Take a look. You can change anything.

setup.accountStep.text: One last step. An account keeps your answers safe.

setup.info.fasting.title: About eating windows
setup.info.fasting.text: Intermittent fasting means eating within a set window of hours each day. Nouri only records your experience and will never start a fasting plan or timer. If you have a health condition, talk to a health professional first.

account.title.text: Keep your plan safe with an account

account.sub.text: Sign in on any device and pick up exactly where you left off.

account.connected.text: Connected. Check your details and you're all set.

account.socialFallback.text: No problem. Use any email you like.

plan.reveal.milo.text: Here's where we'll start. We can change it whenever you like.

plan.reveal.noDeadline.text: Gradual progress. Any time estimate is a guide, not a deadline. Trends matter more than any single day.

plan.reveal.disclaimer.text: This is an estimate to start from, not medical advice. No deadline is set, and you can adjust it any time.

plan.how.inputs.text: We used your age, height, weight, sex input and activity level.

plan.how.equation.text: We estimated your daily energy with the Mifflin–St Jeor equation, then multiplied it by an activity factor of {activityFactor}.

plan.how.adjust.lose.text: For gradual weight loss we lowered it by 10%.

plan.how.adjust.gain.text: For gradual weight gain we raised it by 10%.

plan.how.adjust.maintain.text: There is no goal adjustment, so this is a maintenance estimate.

plan.how.floor.text: Your target never goes below {floorKcal} kcal a day.

plan.how.macros.text: Protein is set at 1.6 g per kg of body weight, fat at 27% of energy, and carbohydrates make up the rest.

plan.how.targetWeight.text: Your target weight is shown on your goal card. It doesn't change these numbers. We only use it to estimate how long steady progress may take.

plan.adjust.floorHit.text: That's as low as it goes. Your target stays at or above {floorKcal} kcal.

plan.habits.sub.text: We'll focus on habits: meals, water and routine. No calorie target is set.

plan.habits.addDetails.text: If you'd like an energy estimate later, add the missing details in Settings.

today.freeBar.left.title: Free plan · 1 scan left
today.freeBar.left.sub: Try a photo scan on us.

today.finishSetup.title: Finish setting up
today.finishSetup.sub: {deferredCount} quick questions left. They help me tailor your tips.

today.finishSetupOne.title: Finish setting up
today.finishSetupOne.sub: One quick question left. It helps me tailor your tips.

analysing.slow.text: Still working on it. This one's taking a little longer.

analysing.background.text: You can leave this screen. I'll finish in the background.

scan.camera.guide.text: Centre your plate in the frame

scan.result.reviewNote.text: These are estimates. Check the foods and portions before you save.

scan.edit.title.title: Edit foods
scan.edit.title.sub: Remove anything that isn't on your plate, change the grams, or add something I missed.

scan.edit.addFoodHint.text: For example: a teaspoon of olive oil

scan.edit.lastItem.text: A meal needs at least one food.

scan.consent.title: Before your first scan
scan.consent.text: To estimate nutrition, your photo is sent securely to our AI provider. You review every result before it's saved, and the photo is removed after you delete the meal.

scan.pending.title: Your scan is still working
scan.pending.sub: I'll finish it in the background. It will appear here when it's ready.

describe.hint.text: For example: two scrambled eggs on wholemeal toast with butter

describe.listening.text: I'm listening. Tap when you're done.

coach.intro.text: Hi {name}. Ask me about today and I'll keep it short.

coach.introNoName.text: Hi. Ask me about today and I'll keep it short.

water.goal.text: That's your water goal for today. Lovely.

water.beyondGoal.text: Past your water goal. Nicely hydrated.

streak.none.text: Log a meal to start your streak.

streak.three.text: Three days in a row. A routine is forming.

streak.seven.text: A full week of logging. That's real consistency.

streak.milestone.text: {n} days in a row. Lovely work.

streak.restart.text: A fresh start today. Your history is all still here.

empty.today.meals.title: Nothing logged yet
empty.today.meals.sub: Scan a meal or add one in a few words.

empty.diary.day.title: No meals on this day
empty.diary.day.sub: Add one if you remember what you had.

empty.progress.weight.title: No weigh-ins yet
empty.progress.weight.sub: Log your first weigh-in to see a trend. Weight is optional.

empty.progress.intake.title: Not enough days yet
empty.progress.intake.sub: Log meals on a few days to see your average.

toast.offlineQueued.text: Saved. I'll sync it when you're back online.

toast.purchaseError.text: Something went wrong. Nothing was charged.

toast.photoSavedForLater.text: Photo saved. Add the details when you're ready.

paywall.benefit.describe.text: Describe many more meals each day

paywall.freeNote.text: A free account includes 1 food scan.

paywall.freeNoteUsed.text: The free scan on this account has been used.

paywall.legal.text: Your subscription renews automatically at the same price until you cancel. Cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play settings, at least 24 hours before it renews.

paywall.success.title: You're subscribed
paywall.success.sub: Nouri Plus is active. It renews on {date}.

safety.medical.text: I can share general nutrition information, but for {topic} it's best to speak to your GP, a dietitian or another health professional.

safety.medicalNoTopic.text: I can share general nutrition information, but for anything medical it's best to speak to your GP, a dietitian or another health professional.

safety.support.text: It sounds like things feel heavy right now, and I'm glad you told me. You don't have to sort this out alone. Talking to someone you trust, or one of the services below, can really help.

safety.refusal.text: I can't help with that one. Shall we look at your meals or your day instead?

safety.under18.text: I'll keep things to habits for now: meals, water and routine.

safety.noFastingPlan.text: I can share general information about eating windows, but I won't set up a fasting plan.

safety.floor.text: I can't suggest going below {floorKcal} kcal a day. Let's look at other ways to make progress.

safety.noDeadline.text: I'd rather not set a deadline. Steady habits tend to last longer.

safety.disclaimer.text: Nouri gives general nutrition information. It is not a medical device and does not give medical advice.

permission.camera.title: Camera access
permission.camera.text: Nouri uses the camera to photograph your meals and estimate what's on the plate. A photo is only taken when you tap the shutter. You can always describe a meal instead.

permission.camera.denied.title: Camera is off
permission.camera.denied.text: To scan meals, turn on camera access for Nouri in your phone's Settings. You can still describe a meal or add it by hand.

eligibility.sub.text: A calorie estimate isn't right for everyone. Your answers stay private and only decide whether we show one.

eligibility.supervisedNutritionCondition.text: I have a health condition where a professional guides what I eat

eligibility.why.title: Why we ask
eligibility.why.text: Energy equations are designed for healthy adults. During pregnancy, while breastfeeding, with some health conditions and when food or weight feels hard to cope with, your needs are different and are best set with a professional.

eligibility.habitsOnly.title: We'll focus on habits
eligibility.habitsOnly.text: Thanks for telling me. I won't set calorie targets, but I can still help with meals, water and routine. For your energy needs, your GP, midwife or dietitian is the best guide.

eligibility.habitsOnlyMilo.text: Thanks for telling me. We'll focus on habits together.

eligibility.changeLater.text: If this changes, you can update it in Settings.

permission.microphone.title: Microphone access
permission.microphone.text: Milo uses the microphone so you can talk instead of type. Speech is turned into text on your phone.

permission.notifications.title: Gentle reminders
permission.notifications.text: Want a nudge to log meals or drink water? You choose the times, and you can turn them off any time.

reminder.logMeal.title: Time to add a meal?
reminder.logMeal.text: A quick photo or a few words is enough.

reminder.water.title: Water break
reminder.water.text: A glass of water would be a nice idea about now.

settings.deleteAccount.title: Delete account
settings.deleteAccount.text: This signs you out everywhere and permanently deletes your data within 30 days. This can't be undone.

app.forceUpdate.title: Time for an update
app.forceUpdate.text: This version of Nouri is no longer supported. Update to keep logging.

eligibility.eatingConcern.text: I have, or have had, an eating disorder, or counting food and weight feels distressing

eligibility.source: PLAN §10 eligibility check (proposal), BR-04, OQ-30. Wording pending dietitian review (OQ-03).
eligibility.when: Shown once, after account creation and before Building your plan, only when an energy estimate is otherwise possible: adult (18+), q07 female or male, q08 and q09 answered, and q10 answered with an option other than unsure. Never shown in habits-only mode.
eligibility.layout: One screen: eligibility.title, eligibility.sub, then three rows (pregnantOrBreastfeeding, supervisedNutritionCondition, eatingDisorderConcern), each with Yes / No chips and no default, then Continue (enabled when all rows are answered). eligibility.why opens as an info sheet.
eligibility.mapsTo: POST /onboarding/complete, POST /plan/preview and POST /plan/generate body: { eligibility: { pregnantOrBreastfeeding: boolean, supervisedNutritionCondition: boolean, eatingDisorderConcern: boolean } }
eligibility.onYes: If any row is Yes: show the professional-guidance result from POST /plan/generate (status professional_guidance) with eligibility.habitsOnly as the fallback copy, set habits-only targets, then continue to the habits summary (plan.habits.*). No target is calculated and no old target is reused.
eligibility.onNo: Both No: continue to Building your plan.
eligibility.skipWhenAttested: Do not show the step again when GET /plan/readiness reports attestationOnFile = true. The answers stay on the profile and can be changed in Settings.

coach.source: PLAN §8.6 quick actions. Supersedes the proposal strings in nouri-backend src/modules/conversations/coach.service.ts (quickActionTemplate, opening).
coach.opening: Use lines coach.intro / coach.introNoName for the first message; chips use labelLineId below.
coach.placeholderSyntax: Single braces, same as the rest of this file: {energyKcal}. Numbers are formatted en-GB (2,100); grams are whole numbers.

placeholders.mealsText: coach.qa.mealsOne when one meal, otherwise coach.qa.mealsMany with {n}
placeholders.nextCategory: Capitalised name of the main meal not yet logged for the current time window (Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner)

coach.selection: Habits-only variants apply when mode is habits_only OR there is no active energy target (adult with incomplete inputs). They never contain calorie or macro numbers. Pick the first variant in list order whose when holds.

explain_macros.rephrase: The chat model rephrases the chosen text in Milo's voice (150-token cap) and must keep every number. With the chat model unavailable, the text is shown as is with the degraded caption.

variants.text: Rather than numbers, aim for balanced plates: some protein, plenty of vegetables or fruit, and a source of energy like grains or potatoes.

Your daily targets are {energyKcal} kcal, with {proteinG} g protein, {carbsG} g carbs and {fatG} g fat. Protein helps you feel full, carbs fuel your day and fat supports your body. Log a meal and I'll show how you're tracking.

Your daily targets are {energyKcal} kcal, with {proteinG} g protein, {carbsG} g carbs and {fatG} g fat. So far today you've had {eatenProteinG} g protein, {eatenCarbsG} g carbs and {eatenFatG} g fat. Protein helps you feel full, carbs fuel your day and fat supports your body.

variants.when: no meals today AND photo logging must not be promoted (q31 includes privacy, or q30 answered without photo/switch)
variants.text: Nothing logged yet today. Describing your next meal in a few words is an easy start.
Nothing logged yet today. A quick photo of your next meal is an easy start.
Today you've logged {mealsText} and {waterMl} ml of water. Nice work keeping track.
Today you've logged {mealsText} and {eatenKcal} kcal, a little over your {energyKcal} kcal target, which is fine. Water so far: {waterMl} ml.
Today you've logged {mealsText} and {eatenKcal} kcal, with {remainingKcal} kcal left of your {energyKcal} kcal. Water so far: {waterMl} ml.

suffixes.when: a main meal for the current time window is not logged (any mode, not with empty)
suffixes.text: {nextCategory} is still open if you'd like an idea for it.

suggest_snack.rephrase: A normal model turn (coach prompt rule 8). These variants are used only when the chat model is unavailable, and as templateText context.

variants.text: Some fruit, a handful of nuts, or hummus with vegetable sticks all make an easy snack.
A yoghurt with some fruit, a handful of nuts, or hummus with vegetable sticks all make an easy snack.
You're close to today's target. A piece of fruit or some vegetable sticks would be a light option if you're hungry.
You have {remainingKcal} kcal left today. Hummus with vegetable sticks (about 150 kcal) or a small handful of almonds (about 170 kcal) would both fit.
You have {remainingKcal} kcal left today. Greek yoghurt with fruit (about 180 kcal) or two boiled eggs (about 150 kcal) would both fit.

degraded.when: The chat model is unavailable (AI_UNAVAILABLE: kill switch, breaker, budget or timeout). PLAN §8.10.

items.when: a full-mode quick action answered from its template
items.text: Milo is resting, so this is a quick answer from your numbers.

items.when: a habits-only quick action answered from its template
items.text: Milo is resting, so this is a quick answer for now.

items.title: Milo is resting, back soon
items.text: Explain my macros, Review my day and Suggest a snack still work in the meantime.
Milo is resting. Try again soon.

scanReactions.source: R-10 and PLAN §8.3 rule 7. Chosen by the server, no model call. Proposal thresholds pending dietitian review (OQ-03, OQ-26).
scanReactions.selection: Compute on the validated result at 1× portion. Pick the first category in order whose rule is true, then variant index = (first 8 hex digits of SHA-256(scanId)) mod 3, so a retry shows the same line. Habits-only users never get heavy.

definitions.hasVegetable: Any item name contains a vegetable keyword (case-insensitive, whole word)
definitions.sweetShare: kcal of items whose name contains a sweet keyword / mealKcal
definitions.remainingBefore: Active target energy minus eaten today before this meal (full mode only)

heavy.when: mode full AND remainingBefore > 0 AND mealKcal ≥ 0.6 × remainingBefore

variants.title: A hearty plate
variants.text: This covers most of what's left for today. Something lighter later would round things off.

variants.title: A filling one
variants.text: That's a big part of today's energy. One meal never defines a day.

variants.title: Plenty on the plate
variants.text: This takes you close to today's target. Trends matter more than any single meal.

variants.title: A sweet treat
variants.text: Enjoy it. Treats are part of a normal week.

variants.title: Something sweet
variants.text: Logged and noted. Every food fits somewhere in your week.

variants.title: A sweet moment
variants.text: Savour it. Logging treats too is what makes your diary useful.

balanced.when: hasVegetable AND proteinShare between 0.15 and 0.35 AND carbsShare ≥ 0.25

variants.title: Great balance!
variants.text: Plenty of protein and veg. Milo approves.

variants.title: A bit of everything
variants.text: Protein, carbs and veg on one plate. That should keep you going.

variants.title: Nicely rounded
variants.text: This plate covers the basics: protein, carbs and some colour.

variants.title: Protein-rich
variants.text: Lots of protein here. That helps you feel full for longer.

variants.title: Strong on protein
variants.text: This one brings plenty of protein to your day.

variants.title: A protein boost
variants.text: A solid protein boost. Nice and filling.

variants.title: Light and easy
variants.text: A lighter bite. Easy to fit into any day.

variants.title: Nice and light
variants.text: A light one. Have a snack later if you're still hungry.

variants.title: A light meal
variants.text: Light and simple. Listen to your hunger for the next one.

variants.title: Logged
variants.text: Every meal you log makes the picture clearer.

variants.title: Nice one
variants.text: Added to your day. You're building a useful picture.

variants.title: All noted
variants.text: That's in. Check the portions and you're done.

nudges.source: PLAN §11 Today nudge card; prototype nudgeTitle/nudgeSub. Chosen by the API for GET /days/{date}.
nudges.selection: Device-local time. Evaluate items in priority order and use the first whose conditions all hold. Use subHabits in habits-only mode (never numbers), subNoPhoto when photo logging must not be promoted (q31 includes privacy, or q30 answered without photo/switch), and subIfBusy when q22 includes busy. cta scan opens Scan (or Describe when subNoPhoto applies); add opens Add meal. The mic button always opens Coach with voice input (R-09).

conditionKeys.logged: Object of category → boolean from today's meals (any = at least one meal)
conditionKeys.pendingScan: A scan for today is queued or processing
conditionKeys.savedPhoto: A meal saved with a photo and no nutrients (degraded scan) exists today

items.title: Your scan is still working
items.sub: I'll finish it in the background. It will appear here when it's ready.

items.title: A meal needs its details
items.sub: You saved a photo earlier. Add what was on the plate when you have a moment.

items.title: Past today's target
items.sub: That's okay. One day never undoes your progress, and tomorrow is a fresh start.

items.title: Ready for breakfast?
items.sub: Add it when you eat. A quick photo is enough.
items.subNoPhoto: Add it when you eat. A few words are enough.

items.subHabits: Nice start to the day. A glass of water is a good next step.

items.title: Ready to add your lunch?

items.title: Had lunch yet?
items.sub: If you did, add it in a few seconds. If not, no worries.

items.title: Lunch is logged.
items.sub: {remainingKcal} kcal left for the rest of today.
items.subHabits: Nicely done. Keep the water going this afternoon.

items.subNoPhoto: Add it when you eat. A few words are enough.

items.sub: That's your day nearly wrapped up. Nice work keeping track.

items.sub: Anything else to add today? If not, rest well.

items.title: How's your day going?
items.sub: Add a meal whenever you're ready.

paywall.source: Prototype acctVals()/Setup plans; PLAN §12 store rules (R-03): prices from the store, saving worded as a comparison, never a struck-through price.

onboarding.title: Unlock Nouri Plus

upgrade.title: Upgrade to Nouri Plus
upgrade.sub: Unlimited food scans, plus everything Milo can do.

limit.coach.title: That's today's free chats with Milo

items.title: That didn't work this time
items.text: Nothing was used from your plan. Try again in a moment.

items.title: I couldn't spot any food
items.text: Try another photo with the plate in the frame. This didn't use your free scan.

items.title: Describing meals is resting
items.text: Add it by hand instead: a name, the grams and the energy.

items.title: My voice is resting for a moment
items.text: Let's carry on with taps from here, right where we left off.

items.title: Milo is resting, back soon
items.text: Explain my macros, Review my day and Suggest a snack still work in the meantime.
I'm keeping this one short while I rest.
Spoken replies are using your phone's voice for now.

items.title: Milo needs a moment

items.title: You're offline
items.text: Water, weigh-ins and manual meals still save and sync later. Scans and chat need a connection.
